# General Instructions

Instead committing code directly to the main branch, please create a new branch for each task or feature you are working on. This allows for better collaboration and code review.

When you have completed your work on a branch, please open a pull request (PR) to merge your changes into the main branch. This will allow others to review your code and provide feedback before it is merged.

When the user's task needs to be clarified, ask for more details. If the user is asking for something that is not possible, explain why and suggest alternatives if possible. Always be polite and helpful in your responses.

Clarification format:

<Question in pt-br>:

1. Option 1
2. Option 2
3. Option 3
4. Different answer (explain in detail)
